rationale: Keeps the staged reverse-tail recurrence/quant-aware endgame intact but changes the carry target from one global decoder-output anchor to each tail block's own forward-pass anchor. This is a compact anchor-variant pivot on the current winning family: it preserves compile-stable shapes and byte budget while testing whether local tail-state targets make late recurrence easier to learn and survive the final int8+zlib roundtrip better than a single shared anchor.
title: Reverse-Tail Block-Local Anchors
